name: Bow Pose
description: Belly-down backbend where the hands hold the ankles and the chest and thighs lift.

source.title: Yoga Journal Pose Library
source.note: Stick-figure approximation. Twists and binds can't be fully shown in 2D.

setup: Lie on your belly with your arms by your sides and your forehead down.
Bend your knees and reach back to hold the outsides of your ankles.

keyframes.name: Lie on your belly
keyframes.cue: Lie face down with the arms along your sides.

keyframes.name: Bow Pose
keyframes.cue: Bend the knees, hold the ankles, and lift the chest and thighs.

cues: Kick the feet into the hands to lift.
